tx_board.name: S10
tx_board.notes: TX/DAC board (Zynq-7010). AXI DMA MM2S only; drives the AD9764 through an interpolating CIC. Register map: lib/hw/board_map.h, namespace tx_board. serial_port is null on purpose -- port assignments are not static; set it from the Port menu or --port per session.

tx.notes: Board-side path observed loading successfully with `sudo fpgautil -b`. Its design name does not obviously correspond to m10_dac_iq_v6.xsa, which is what the tx_board register map was verified against -- confirm the two agree, or correct this path.

rx_board.name: M20(1)
rx_board.notes: RX/ADC board (Zynq-7020). AXI DMA S2MM only, with DRE; ADC through a decimating CIC and a DDS mixer. Register map: lib/hw/board_map.h, namespace rx_board. (The m20 XSA is named '_dac_' but is the ADC/RX design.)

rx.notes: NOT CONFIGURED. Set this to the board-side path of the staged .bit.bin for the RX design, e.g. firmware/<name>.bit.bin. Until then everything except the bitstream load works, and Load Bitstream reports this field as the thing to fill in.
